messages:
Renee (CS): Pri from Meridian AP says they can't route the renewal PO unless the signoff shows the correct billing entity and vendor code. DocuSign envelope lists 'Meridian Group' only.
Omar (AM): Which billing entity do they need?
Priya (Customer Finance): Meridian Labs Ltd (VAT: IE1234567). Vendor code: MER-LABS-90. Also they asked for invoice split: $75k US ops, 35k EU ops.
Leah (Ops): Can send a one-page approval stub PDF that lists both line items and vendor code. Will also add the standard legal caveat.
DocuSign Bot: Alert: envelope b7c2d1e4 has billing_entity mismatch.
Victor (Legal): Stub must include: "This approval is for procurement routing only and does not amend the Agreement." Add name/title/email fields and PO number line.
Renee (CS): Customer prefers a direct PDF emailed to ap@meridianlabs.ie rather than a DocuSign link.
Leah (Ops): Drafting now. I'll upload to Box and send DocSend for tracking.
Omar (AM): If they insist on DocuSign, can we correct envelope metadata?
Leah (Ops): Yes but that takes ~48 hours to propagate for signed envelopes. Stub is fastest.
Priya (Customer Finance): PDF emailed is fine for AP workflow. Please include contact finance@redwood.com for verification.
Leah (Ops): Done. DocSend: https://docsend.com/view/meridian-stub-1765432101. Box path /Approvals/meridian/1765432101-stub.pdf.
Renee (CS): Sent to Pri and cc'd the customer. Asked AP to attach stub to PO and confirm PO number.
Victor (Legal): I'll add a short audit memo to the customer record confirming exception acceptance for < $200k.
Priya (Customer Finance): AP confirmed PO routed. PO# M-2026-778. Attaching when received. :thumbsup:
Leah (Ops): Created ticket OPS-8019 to fix default billing entity mapping for Meridian envelopes.
Renee (CS): Closing thread pending final PO upload. Reopen if any mismatch on invoice vs PO.
